Slit2_trabecular.interpretation: Exact author Table3 top10 state markers. The paper describes Slit2.CMs as trabecular ventricular CMs; our RNA-based label remains a spatial candidate. Etv1/Gja5 overlap conduction biology and are not independent proof of Purkinje identity.
Slit2_trabecular.gene_set_origin: Supplementary Table3 state markers, exact author top10; same dataset, not independent validation.

Ankrd1_response.interpretation: Exact author Table3 top10 state markers. Paper spatial association with LV/peri-arteriolar regions and strain; not measured mechanical load here.
Ankrd1_response.gene_set_origin: Supplementary Table3 state markers, exact author top10; same dataset, not independent validation.

HIF_response.interpretation: Curated subset of HALLMARK_HYPOXIA, not complete hallmark signature. Many genes also respond to growth/metabolism. Requires non-glycolytic anchors; Hif1a RNA is not used as oxygen measurement.

HIF_non_glycolytic.interpretation: Specificity sensitivity excluding glycolytic enzymes, still not direct oxygen or HIF protein activity.

Glycolysis.interpretation: Canonical enzyme/transport panel; neonatal maturation and glycolytic baseline are alternatives to hypoxia.

Oxidative_metabolism.interpretation: Exploratory nuclear respiratory-chain panel, not complete hallmark set or measured respiratory capacity. Mitochondrial genes excluded.

Fatty_acid_oxidation.interpretation: Canonical enzyme panel; not measured flux and not a specific oxygen readout.

Sarcomere_mechanics.interpretation: Exploratory structural/costamere apparatus, not proof of activated mechanical sensing or increased load.

IEG_preparation.interpretation: Shared stress/dissociation-response alternatives; nuclear preparation differs from whole-cell dissociation. Also responds in vivo.

Compact_developmental.interpretation: Morphogenesis-era associations, not specific mature transmural position. Hey2 is not spatially exclusive.

Trabecular_developmental.interpretation: Contextual embryonic/developmental association, not adult endocardial location; overlaps conduction/load programs.

Conduction_overlap.interpretation: Exploratory overlap check, not a main-paper signature and not Purkinje identity. Some markers overlap trabecular myocardium.

Cycling.interpretation: Replication/cycling transcription, not completed cardiomyocyte division.

Maturation_reference.interpretation: Exploratory reference, not author maturation index or a validated maturity score; comparisons are within stage only.

Ddc_reference.gene_set_origin: Supplementary Table3 state markers, exact author top10; same dataset, not independent validation.
Ddc_reference.interpretation: Ddc-associated author ventricular state, not direct oxygen or wall-depth classification.

gate.reference: 1,214 previous CAR_3/CAR_9; Slit2-enriched ambiguous ventricular/conduction-overlap reference

design: Unsupervised stage-specific all-gene-HVG discovery; program scores/handpicked-only gene sets are not clustering inputs. Primary HVGs can include interpreted genes. Programs are interpreted post hoc, with a separate all-program-gene exclusion sensitivity.
notes: Exact author Table3 state panels are separated from exploratory canonical process panels; same-dataset reference signatures are not independent validation.
No direct spatial, oxygen, mechanical load, metabolic flux or functional measurement.
Program z-scores are standardized separately per original library within stage; not across-age absolute scores.
Do not classify cells from one gene or equate HIF/glycolysis with measured hypoxia.
Primary paper-state programs use exact Table3 markers. Other panels are exploratory canonical subsets, not transferred full pathway signatures.
